subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words:

Constant efforts to achieve something
solution:
The correct answer is: **Perseverance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Perseverance"** refers to the continuous effort to achieve something despite difficulties or obstacles. (दृढ़ता)

 
 
• **Example:** Her perseverance in completing the marathon, even after an injury, was truly inspiring.
 
 
 
• This quality involves staying determined and focused over a long period, even when success seems distant. (दृढ़ निश्चय)
 
 
• **Example:** He showed great perseverance by working on his project every day for a year without giving up.
 
 
 
• Hence, constant efforts to achieve something can be best described by the term **"Perseverance"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Perseverance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Revert** (लौटना): To return to a previous state or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** After the experiment failed, the scientist decided to revert to the original plan.
 
 
 
• **Euphemism** (शिष्ट भाषा): A mild or indirect term used to replace a harsh or offensive one.
 
 
• **Example:** "Passed away" is a euphemism for "died."
 
 
 
• **Perspicacious** (सूझ-बूझ वाला): Having keen insight or understanding.
 
 
• **Example:** Her perspicacious observations about the market helped the company make better decisions.
